releases.notes:
# Changelog
 - Updated to 1.20.5/6
 - Player skins now update immediately when they are returned from the server or cleared from the cache
 - The valhalla skin server type now uses api version 1 @killjoy1221 
 - The valhalla skin server type now supports skin history
 - The `disablePantsButton` has been replaced with `pantsButtonVisibility` and can be set to `AUTO` to only hide the button when mod menu is installed. 
 - Updated the yggdrasil skin server implementation with tentative support for uri uploads

# Experimental
 - Added an option to fetch player skins in bulk. This can be enabled in the config `useBatchLoading` to `true`.

# Bugs Deepfried
 - Fixed the clear all button
 - Fixed upload buttons not being disabled when the session is invalid
 - Fixed duplicate skin error. Duplicates will now be silently ignored. Use the "clear all" button to clean up duplicated skins

releases.notes:
**Note: If you're using Mine Little Pony, make sure you have at least version 4.10.0 as older versions are no longer compatible**

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/182492627059343360/1129451903475003442/image.png)

# Alternate Versions
[Minecraft 1.19.4](https://github.com/MineLittlePony/HDSkins/releases/tag/6.10.2%2B1.19.4)
[Minecraft 1.19.3](https://github.com/MineLittlePony/HDSkins/releases/tag/6.10.2%2B1.19.3)
[Minecraft 1.19.2](https://github.com/MineLittlePony/HDSkins/releases/tag/6.10.2%2B1.19.2)

# Changelog 6.10.2
 - Added an option to disable the flatpak environment detection (appears to cause issues on some setups)

# Changelog 6.10.1
 - Fixed incorrectly showing "invalid session" for sessions that are valid

# Changelog 6.10.0
- Added a new skinning gui that should be less confusing and easier to use!
  - The skin type selector is more prominent and positioned to indicate that it applies to both local and remote
  - Skin types have their own fancy new icons
  - Buttons that affect the server-stored skin are listed on the right, under the server-side carousel
  - Buttons affecting the local preview, posing, etc are on the left, under the local preview player
  - Icons that previously used text symbols like ">>" or "<<" now have their own custom icons
  - Player pose and arm shape have custom icons instead of using item stacks, and have slightly more descriptive tooltips
  - Added a "clear all" button to clear all applied skins
  - The remote carousel will now display an error status when your session is invalid
  - Error messages in both carousels now properly render with red text when they're supposed to

# Bugs Sizzled
- Fixed layering of text above the player models
- Fixed mismatched arm shape and textures
- Fixed crash with sodium/iris
- Removed console logs of form request bodies
- [Fixed skin switcher not always updating with the full set of server-responded skin types](https://github.com/MineLittlePony/HDSkins/commit/76a1a22c05077d4bc4d61f266d10f4cf9deb4a7a)
